Trip Types

One booking format for every kind of outstation trip

Whether you need a quick one-way drop or a week-long road trip with multiple stops — the booking is the same.

One-Way Drop

Get dropped at your destination and the trip ends there — no need to book a return. Enter your route to see the fare before you confirm.

Single direction

  • Round Trip: Outstation and back with the same driver. The car stays with you for the entire trip — explore freely, stop anywhere. Driver stays with you
  • Multi-City: Cover multiple stops across cities — Bangalore → Mysore → Coorg → Bangalore. One booking, one fare, zero hassle. Multiple stops, one fare

Transparent Pricing

Everything included in your fare

ABHI CABS 24×7Outstation fare

Included in your fare

  • Base fare and fuel charges
  • Driver allowance (bata)
  • GST where applicable (shown in fare breakup)
  • AC vehicle

Charged separately (at actuals)

  • Toll / State tax (as per actuals)
  • Parking charges
  • Extra km beyond package limit
  • Night driving allowance (9:45 PM – 6 AM) — ₹300/night, paid to driver

The exact fare — including any applicable night charge or surcharge — is confirmed on the checkout page before you pay. No surprises, ever.

How It Works

Book in under a minute

  1. Enter your route

    Pick up, drop off, date and time — your fare shows instantly.

  2. Choose your cab

    Sedan, SUV, or tempo traveller. See the exact fare before you pay.

  3. Confirm & ride

    Your driver is assigned, GPS-tracked, and ready at your doorstep.
